text: Horrible app, charged me after canceling subscriptions and won't let me delete the account. Total scam. Also signed me up for services without my consent.
author: Ingrid Roos
developer_reply: We understand the concern about unexpected charges and account management. The renewal policies and instructions for cancellation can be found at help.thefabulous.co. Users can also submit a refund request there for further assistance. We appreciate the feedback. The Fabulous Member Care team.

text: I feel fabulous, as their users, has improved over time. I like the daily coaching messages, as they are more varied and also seem to be tailored to the rigjt occasion and time. The design could be a bit more sleek, but that isn't a deal breaker. As to the journeys - some of them feel like they're very US centered. Cutting out sugar interely or looking at the ingredients list to understand, which food is "processed", seems like an oversimplification.
